newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to tender to sell 250,000 T barley Aug 26.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to tender to sell 250,000 T barley Aug 26.

text.p: Turkey's state Grain Board (TMO) will hold a tender on August 26 to export 250,000 tonnes of white feed barley, board officials said on Monday.
They said the barley would be from the TMO's purchases from the 1997/98 crop, which so far total 1.68 million tonnes .
According to the tender terms, the TMO will sell 150,000 tonnes out of Mersin and 100,000 tonnes out of Derince.
It said 50,000 tonnes of the total Mersin shipment would be for Sept 15-Oct 25, 50,000 for Sept 25-Oct 10 and 50,000 for Oct 15-25.
Of the total Derince shipment, 50,000 tonnes would be for Sept 20-Oct 5 and 50,000 for Oct 15-25.
